change.observedProblem: Advisor, workflow and backup lease expiry was auditable but a 1–2 person operator had no permission-scoped queue for investigating possible partial effects and recording a non-replay resolution.
implementedBehavior: GET /api/v1/operations/incidents derives organization-scoped open or resolved incidents from append-only lease_expired audits for advisor runs, workflow runs and database backups.

POST /api/v1/operations/incidents/:id/resolve requires a 20-character review, at least one stable evidence reference, an explicit no-replay acknowledgement and a primary compensation reference when compensation was required.
Recorded advisor output, workflow checkpoints or backup artifacts force manual_compensation_completed and prevent a no-partial-effects claim.
An event-scoped PostgreSQL transaction advisory lock permits exactly one valid manual_review_completed audit without UPDATE or DELETE permission on audit_events.
The original failed status, version, error and partial output remain unchanged; the endpoint does not call a model, run workflow steps, enqueue a job or execute a backup command.
Malformed legacy or forged resolution metadata cannot hide an open incident; cross-organization IDs are returned as 404 and duplicate resolution is 409.
Only owner and admin receive the read/update permissions by default; an existing organization must use an approved system-role-maintenance operation to add them.
